The duo

Every hero needs support.

Two products, designed as one routine. Twenty ingredients between them, every amount published.

The main character

Saede Hero

Daily capsule

The daily capsule, and the main character. Hero goes after the root causes rather than the symptom — the androgen activity, the stress load, and the micronutrients your hair is actually built from.

This is the part of the routine our founder found first, and the reason her hair loss slowed the first time.

  • Saw palmetto, standardised extract
  • Pumpkin seed
  • Iron, in a well-absorbed form
  • Zinc
  • Biotin
  • One capsule daily, with food

Why two

Because one format cannot carry all of it.

The root-cause botanicals and the micronutrients belong in a capsule: a precise, stable, measured dose you swallow in seconds without tasting anything.

The collagen and the inositols do not fit in a capsule. Not because of formulation cleverness — because of arithmetic. Our collagen is 5 g and our myo-inositol is 4 g. That is nine grams from two ingredients alone.

  • A capsule holds milligrams. A scoop holds grams.
  • To deliver 9 g in capsules you would swallow a fistful a day
  • So most brands quietly shrink the dose to whatever fits — and still put the ingredient on the front of the box
  • We would rather give you a powder and tell you why

How to take it

How to take it.

Saede Hero — one capsule a day, with food. Taking it with a meal helps absorption and is gentler on the stomach.

Saede Support — one scoop a day, stirred into whatever you already have. Coffee, water, juice, a smoothie. Sonja puts hers in yogurt. It dissolves easily and is gentle to digest, so it fits into your morning rather than becoming another task.

Whenever you will actually remember is the right time. Consistency over six months beats perfect timing over three weeks, every time.

Both, every 28 days.

The duo is designed to be taken together, which is how membership delivers it.
